title: The Heavenly Eye Awakens
next_chapter_hook: Those eyes seemed to pierce through Chen Ji's soul, conveying information beyond language: 'Chess piece, you have finally been seen.'

text.content:
Deep night, at the Cliff Edge of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain.

Chen Ji sat cross-legged on a blue stone, spiritual energy flowing around him as usual, his expression still that of a dull and timid appearance—this was thetrash人设 he had maintained for twenty years.

His fingers unconsciously rubbed his chest, where the faint warmth of the Tianji Record Fragment lay hidden. The feigned death scheme had successfully deceived the entire sect, even Inner Disciple Senior Fellow Su Qingyao believed he was severely injured and in seclusion.

The night wind carried a sense of wrongness.

Not killing intent, not prying gazes, but an indescribable 'sensation of being watched'—as if the entire heavens and earth were examining him in some way beyond mortal comprehension.

Chen Ji's eyelids trembled slightly. He was no stranger to this sensation. He had experienced the gaze of the Heavenly Secrets' eye countless times, each encounter bringing familiar oppression and the weight of destiny.

But tonight was different.

Above the heavens, the crescent moon suddenly cracked open a fissure.

Within the fissure was not darkness, but an eye—vertical golden pupils, impossibly vast, as if the entire heavens were merely its eyelid. Countless runes layered across its surface, complex enough to induce vertigo, each rune speaking of ancient laws that did not belong to the mortal world.

The air around Chen Ji froze instantly.

An indescribable pressure descended like a physical force, pinning his entire body to the blue stone. His breathing became labored, every bone creaking as if about to shatter at any moment.

This was not the Heavenly Secrets' eye's method.

Chen Ji made an instant judgment—he had never felt so... insignificant under the Heavenly Secrets' eye's gaze.

Golden patterns spread from his dantian, crawling through his meridians. That was the dragon vein core resonating—the will of the forty-ninth chess piece sleeping on the first page of the Tianji Record, awakening now in an almost frantic manner.

Chen Ji死死 pressed down the surging power within him.

He could not expose himself. Not now.

'You...'

Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, barely recognizable as his own. That eye had no emotional fluctuations, merely continuing to pour down pressure, as if probing, examining.

His spine bent inch by inch, his knees beginning to weaken. But deep within his gaze, a cold light was凝聚ing.

Remembered.

He recited silently in his heart. Whoever you are, I have remembered.

'Heh...'

A light laugh escaped from between Chen Ji's teeth. Blood slid down his nostrils, dripping onto the blue stone, gleaming in the moonlight.

He slowly raised his head, directly confronting that eye spanning the heavens.

'The Heavenly Secrets' eye I endured through.' His voice was very soft, yet each word was clear, 'What... exactly are you?'

The pressure suddenly intensified.

Blood seeped from all seven orifices on Chen Ji's body, his internal organs feeling like they were being kneaded by invisible hands, the intense pain almost tearing his sanity apart. But his spine remained straight—even if bent to its absolute limit.

This was the first time he had refused to bow his head before an absolute powerhouse.

'Interesting.'

A voice rang directly in his mind, ancient, authoritative, carrying a sense of lofty amusement.

'The host of the forty-ninth chess piece... the inheritor of the Tianji Record's fragment...' the voice articulated word by word, 'So, you have actually reached this step.'

Chen Ji's heart sank sharply.

Chessboard Guardian. Nemesis. Nemesis...

These terms exploded in his mind like thunder. The chess game entangled with the Tianji Record was far vaster than he had imagined. And he, who always thought he was the one placing pieces and laying plans on the chessboard—

Turns out, he was also a chess piece.

'But you are more interesting than I imagined.' the voice continued, 'Knowing you are a chess piece yet not collapsing, instead calculating how to turn the tables...'

The eye in the heavens narrowed slightly.

'This kind of mentality, qualifies you to know more.'

Before the words finished, the pressure vanished abruptly.

Chen Ji collapsed onto the blue stone, gasping heavily. Moonlight fell again, everything seemingly just an illusion.

But he knew it was not an illusion.

Because the dragon vein core in his dantian was currently operating at an unprecedented speed, as if digesting something... or, fearing something.

Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, forcing down the boiling emotions.

Endure. It was still too early to reveal himself. This existence's level far exceeded the Heavenly Secrets' eye; he needed time, needed intelligence, needed more trump cards.

'I understand.' he recited silently in his heart, 'You want to see me struggle... then I will struggle for you to see.'

He wiped away the blood on his face, sat cross-legged again, closing his eyes and feigning meditation.

But deep within his consciousness, the Tianji Record Fragment was vibrating intensely—the seal pattern left by Mo Xiansheng on the first page was flickering at a诡异 frequency, as if resonating with some distant existence.

Mo Xiansheng... just how much have you been hiding from me?

text.content:
Chen Ji stood motionless, as if truly scared out of his wits.

That eye observed him for a moment, seemingly evaluating something. A moment later, the pressure receded like an ebbing tide, the fissure in the heavens healing slowly.

But before disappearing, that voice rang out once more: 'Interesting... you will be the most interesting chess piece I've ever seen.'

Moonlight fell once more.

Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, a cold smile curving his lips.

'A chess piece... is it.' his voice was very soft, 'Then let's see who gets eaten first.'

He stood up, stumbling toward the cave. His Heavenly Fate Value had consumed another five points, but the intelligence gained was worth it.

text.content:
Chen Ji suddenly stood up, the power of the dragon vein core released without any reservation.

Golden patterns emerged from beneath his skin, the entire person like an unsheathed sword, pointing directly at the heavens.

'Since I have already entered this game—' his voice was ice-cold yet resolute, 'Then tell me, on this chessboard, how many Chess Players are there?'

The eye in the heavens flickered, seemingly not expecting him to resist.

A moment later, that voice rang out again, with a hint of amusement:

'Interesting... those chosen by the Tianji Record are indeed all somewhat intriguing.' the voice paused, 'Want to know the answer? Then strive to survive—when you collect all nine fragments, you will naturally know.'

Those eyes seemed to pierce through Chen Ji's soul, conveying information beyond language:

'Chess piece, you have finally been seen.'
